moment: It is evidence against the cat who carried it. The orange projection turns its head and speaks your name in your own voice. Every rooftop cat in Faelspire falls silent. The silence is worse than the screaming. The stray looks up. “They know which cat to ask next.”
style: Engraved etching illustration, dense crosshatching, fine ink linework, strong black ink, monochrome, no colour. The characters are anthropomorphic cats.
